welcome.subject: Welcome to BLENDi Pulse!
welcome.opening: Your BLENDi Pulse account is ready. Let's get started.
steps: Set your goals in your profile
Make your first Blend — let Pulse AI suggest the perfect recipe
Track your hydration and macros in the Track tab
Come back every week to see your Weekly Report and unlock achievements

features.name: Pulse AI
features.description: Describe what you want, and the AI builds the perfect blend recipe for you, instantly.

features.name: Pantry Scanner
features.description: Snap a photo of your fridge or pantry, and the AI identifies your ingredients to suggest recipes with what you already have.

welcome.more_text: And there's a lot more waiting for you in the app.
welcome.closing: Just open the app and start blending.

password_reset.subject: Reset your BLENDi Pulse password
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your BLENDi Pulse password. Use the verification code below to continue. Do not share this code with anyone.
password_reset.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your account remains secure.
